name: input-group
title: Input Group
description: Add addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Marks the group as disabled. Sets `aria-disabled="true"` on the root (the
ARIA signal that the group's addons are dimmed for) and `data-disabled`,
which every descendant addon restyles against via `group-data-*`
selectors — mirrors `Field`'s `disabled` prop. Does not itself disable
the inner control; pass `disabled` to `InputGroupInput`/
`InputGroupTextarea` (or a custom control) too, same as `Field`.

examples.title: Default
examples.source:
import InputGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input-group.marko";
import InputGroupInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input.marko";
import InputGroupAddon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/addon.marko";

<InputGroup>
  <InputGroupInput placeholder="Search..." />
  <InputGroupAddon>
    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
      <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/>
    </svg>
  </InputGroupAddon>
</InputGroup>
examples.description: An `InputGroupAddon` defaults to `align="inline-start"` and sits before the input in the DOM for proper focus handling.

examples.title: Inline start
examples.source:
import InputGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input-group.marko";
import InputGroupInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input.marko";
import InputGroupAddon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/addon.marko";

<InputGroup>
  <InputGroupAddon align="inline-start">
    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>

examples.description: Use `align="inline-start"` to position the addon at the start of the input. This is the default.

examples.title: Inline end
examples.description: Use `align="inline-end"` to position the addon at the end of the input.

examples.title: Block start
examples.description: Use `align="block-start"` to position the addon above the input, most useful with `InputGroupTextarea`.

examples.title: Block end
examples.description: Use `align="block-end"` to position the addon below the input.

examples.title: Button
examples.source:
import InputGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input-group.marko";
import InputGroupInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input.marko";
import InputGroupAddon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/addon.marko";
import InputGroupButton from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/button.marko";

<InputGroup>
  <InputGroupInput placeholder="Search documentation..." />
  <InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">
    <InputGroupButton size="icon-xs" aria-label="Search">
      <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
        <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
        <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/>
      </svg>
    </InputGroupButton>
  </InputGroupAddon>
</InputGroup>
examples.description: `InputGroupButton` renders a compact button sized to sit inside the group; pass `size="icon-xs"` for icon-only actions.

examples.title: Kbd
examples.source:
import InputGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input-group.marko";
import InputGroupInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input.marko";
import InputGroupAddon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/addon.marko";
import Kbd from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/kbd/kbd.marko";

<InputGroup class="max-w-sm">
  <InputGroupInput placeholder="Search..."/>
  <InputGroupAddon>
    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="text-muted-foreground">
      <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
      <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/>

examples.title: Textarea
examples.source:
import InputGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input-group.marko";
import InputGroupTextarea from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/textarea.marko";
import InputGroupAddon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/addon.marko";
import InputGroupButton from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/button.marko";

<InputGroup>
  <InputGroupAddon align="block-start">
    <InputGroupButton size="sm" variant="ghost">Bold</InputGroupButton>
    <InputGroupButton size="sm" variant="ghost">Italic</InputGroupButton>
  </InputGroupAddon>
  <InputGroupTextarea placeholder="Type your message..." rows="4" />
  <InputGroupAddon align="block-end">
    <InputGroupButton size="sm" variant="default">Send</InputGroupButton>
  </InputGroupAddon>
</InputGroup>
examples.description: `InputGroupTextarea` pairs with block-aligned addons to build a comment or chat composer.
